title.zh: 圆的认识 · 圆规、半径与 π
title.en: The Circle · Compass, Radius and π

description.zh: 圆是到圆心等距的点；周长与直径之比是固定的 π，面积 π r²。π 用多边形逼近展示，假设理想平面圆。
description.en: A circle is the set of points at a fixed distance from the centre; circumference over diameter is the constant π and area is πr². π is shown by polygon approximation on an ideal plane circle.

label.en: The circle underlies the unit circle

reason.zh: 先认识半径、周长与 π，再把半径取为 1，就得到用来定义角和三角函数的单位圆。
reason.en: Once radius, circumference and π are understood, taking the radius as 1 gives the unit circle used to define angles and trigonometric functions.

title.en: Where does π actually come from?

ask.zh: 量几个大小不同的圆，周长除以直径，结果有什么共同点？
ask.en: Measure circles of different sizes and divide each circumference by its diameter — what do the answers have in common?

ask.zh: 半径是 1 的圆，周长是多少？这个结果和 π 有什么关系？
ask.en: For a circle of radius 1, what is the circumference, and how does that relate to π?

reveal.zh: 不管圆多大，周长÷直径总是一个固定数，就是 π；半径 1 的圆周长正好是 2π。
reveal.en: No matter the size, circumference ÷ diameter is always the same constant, π; a radius-1 circle has circumference 2π.
